title: Add proof-skills as a federated marketplace entry

finalSummary: Dispatched by opum-agent (OPAG-437, operator ruling 2026-09-25: MIT-license and publish proof-skills under Opum AI). Layout question (git-subdir vs repo-root) measured against this repo's own check-federated-pins.mjs/check-federated-content.mjs/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs: none handle git-subdir without a code change (classifyEntry hardcodes source==='github'; resolveSubtree only walks one level into the root tree; the Codex generator's own test already locks in 'throw on git-subdir'), and Codex's per-plugin source has no documented subdirectory field -- opum-agent ruled repo-root. v0.1.0 (plugins/proof-skills/ subdir layout) stays published, unpinned, never re-cut (OMARK-43's tag-mutation concern). Added proof-skills@v0.1.1 (repo-root layout) as a fourth plugins[] entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (github source, author {name: Opum AI, url: https://github.com/opum-ai}, category verification, homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/proof-skills). Independently re-resolved the tag chain via the GitHub API and cross-checked via git ls-remote --tags, not taken from opum-agent's relay: tag object eb96f9681363f34d369612059814e17a300afd8f -> commit 578749fd8baa6456d89d7a0037c88bc09a89213d (== main HEAD) -> root tree 9a53258d828aee4b8d474b6428f8dc0fbf9661d5 -> skills subtree 24b1cbc1685248b1a3b2a30ffb2b854a43efd050, recorded in scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json. Regenerated .agents/plugins/marketplace.json (node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs). Updated README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md from two/three plugins to four. lore check: 0 errors. Full 25-case existing JS test suite unchanged. PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#164 (head 69c17bb): check · manifests, Tracker integrity, and lore check all green -- confirmed from the raw job logs (run 36202929548), not just the checkmark: 'federated pins OK (3 of 4 entries checked: opum-lore, opum-quest, proof-skills)' and 'federated content OK (3 of 4 entries resolved and matched their baseline: opum-lore, opum-quest, proof-skills)', naming proof-skills explicitly rather than silently skipping it. Squash-merged to dev at 56fadd9. Promoted dev to main via git push origin origin/dev:main; verified by fetching origin/main directly (git rev-parse and gh api git/ref/heads/main both independently read 56fadd9dcecb30485173c53aa80161d69392e884). Confirmed required checks on main's own ruleset (check · manifests, Tracker integrity, lore check) via gh api repos/.../rules/branches/main, then confirmed green on 56fadd9 via the push-triggered run opum-ai/opum-marketplace run 36203065242 (job 'check · manifests'), whose log shows 'manifests OK (4 plugin(s): opum-lore, opum-output-styles, opum-quest, proof-skills)' and 'federated content OK (3 of 4 entries resolved and matched their baseline: ..., proof-skills; 1 out of scope)' -- the live pin-version check is PR-only by design (per this repo's own CLAUDE.md) and correctly shows as skipped on the push-to-main run, not a gap.
